assets.credit: F. W. Edmonds, Taking the Census, 1854. Public domain.
assets.depicts: Illustrative: an 1854 American genre painting of a census taker writing in a book while a family answers and children listen; stands in for the credit correspondents who wrote down what locals said.

assets.credit: F. W. Edmonds, The Speculator, 1852. Public domain.
assets.depicts: Illustrative: an 1852 genre painting of a man in a frock coat reading a paper to a farm couple; not Lewis Tappan.

assets.credit: F. W. Edmonds, All Talk and No Work, 1855. Public domain.
assets.depicts: Illustrative: two men talking in a barn doorway, 1855-56; stands in for local talk about a neighbor.

assets.credit: E. L. Henry, The Country Store, 1885. SAAM. Public domain.
assets.depicts: Illustrative: an 1885 painting of shoppers in an American country store; not the Retail Credit Company.

assets.credit: F. W. Edmonds, The New Bonnet, 1858. Public domain.
assets.depicts: Illustrative: an 1858 painting of a family inspecting a newly bought bonnet; stands in for shoppers' private lives.
